cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

mechanism: A controls the order of commitment and explanation, granting access to unclear stakes only after B joins A side through a badge or signature.
confusable: D169 recruits shared responsibility with explicit outcome; D199 seeks alignment before full stakes are disclosed, so withholding must remain active.
comparison: Quiz badge uses low-cost clothing agreement as first commitment; fete entry uses partnership status as prerequisite for penalty discussion.
seedUse: Read both full cards and four canonical seeds. Preserve unknown stakes deliberately; do not invent a penalty in evidence or equate a request with actual consent.
